headline: Gold and silver fall again today; 24K gold at ₹13,326 per gram, silver at ₹1,85,000 per kg
summary: Today's change is a drop of ₹278 per gram for 24K gold (about 2.04% lower than yesterday's ₹13,604) and ₹5,000 per kg for silver (about 2.63% lower). Over the last 7 days, 24K gold is down about 6.14% and silver about 7.5%, and in the last 24 days of recorded data silver has fallen about 15.91% from its ₹2,20,000 per kg level on 26 October. Today's rates are the lowest in the recorded history, and international spot prices were unchanged from today's rate at the time of this note, so the likely drivers are movements in global prices, the US dollar against the rupee, and domestic demand, though these are possibilities rather than confirmed causes.
outlook: If you are buying jewellery or coins, compare the making charges and GST across shops, since the base metal price has come down, and avoid rushing a purchase based on a single day's move.
